cost_statement:
SURETY REAL LANE, M5 (row M443): what this run can cost, before anything starts.
Expected: about 5 USD in Claude Code's own estimates (BS5 §12; E139 item 7, E140 N3), drawn from your subscription's usage limits, which your own Claude use shares.
  Three sessions of a few turns each on Opus (Vision optional), about twelve to sixteen one-shot runs on Sonnet (two check authorings, four Builders, four Verifiers, four Reviewers, two phase verifications, one replan, one Spec Writer change run, plus repairs).
  The qualification attempts, once per run directory and per model: Opus with the continuation canary, Sonnet; under 0.50 USD (E146 item 5's was 0.088 USD).
At most: each run (a session is one run) is bounded by 2000000 billable tokens; the project's day limit of 30 USD in estimates stops it earlier, and its day bound on unknown usage is 4000000 tokens, twice the run cap (caps of Sean's choice, 2026-10-14, the unknown-usage bound the driver's ruling under it; the estimate stays as above). A session turn whose usage Claude Code does not report reserves the run's whole allowance and closes the session (D1 §13.3). The only hard maximum is your subscription's own usage limits.
An estimate, not a cap and not an authorization. Nothing paid starts before your qualification_approval and trust_activation.
